sections.Profile:
Using the movie adaptation of the classic Western TV series as a backdrop, players win poker hands at the drop-target banks to earn chips that start modes, working toward a four-ball Poker Championship. Designed by Tim Seckel with art by Morgan Weistling, the four-player Data East game went into production in September 1994 with a 192x64 dot-matrix display.
